clarification_drawer.note: sms_sent is a longtext SMS body. It is free-text authored by DigiCow staff addressing farmers by name/number in the body — meaning it can (and typically does) carry embedded direct PII. Two viable rulings: (a) INCLUDE with mask_regex_scrub — treat like ussd_question_response.question_string, accept residual leakage risk (regex won't catch every name); or (b) EXCLUDE — treat as untrusted PII surface, drop from training corpus entirely. Cautious-default applied: EXCLUDE. Owner ruling requested before this column can ever cross the seam.
